title: A 639-Year-Long John Cage Performance Had Its First Chord Change In Two Years

title: Uffizi Unveils Plans for $58 Million Transformation
summary: The Uffizi in Florence has announced a €50 million ($58 million) restoration plan that it expects to carry out over the course of two years.
